vertebrae.benchmark
===================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.benchmark

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Benchmark runner.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.benchmark.Benchmark


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: Benchmark(dataset, extractors = None, scoring_config = None, stability_config = None, probe_config = None, cache_config = None, embedding_config = None, memory_config = None, execution = None)

   Run one or more extractors against a labeled dataset.

   :param dataset: Dataset object with inputs and labels.
   :param extractors: Optional iterable of extractors to evaluate.
   :param scoring_config: OverlapIndex scoring configuration.
   :param stability_config: Stability-analysis configuration.
   :param probe_config: Probe-classifier configuration.
   :param cache_config: Embedding cache configuration.
   :param embedding_config: Embedding batching and streaming configuration.
   :param execution: Local execution backend.


   .. py:method:: add_extractor(extractor)

      Add an extractor to this benchmark.

      :param extractor: Feature extractor implementing the vertebrae protocol.

      :returns: This benchmark instance for fluent chaining.



   .. py:method:: run()

      Run feature extraction, scoring, optional probes, and reporting aggregation.

      :returns: Aggregated benchmark result.

      :raises ValueError: If no extractors are configured or dataset validation fails.
